span.p:
Fast mode
- pooled encoder, no encState
- inline strings always
- QPack slice codecs if OptQPack
- pooled buffer, lazily allocated
- Markov-0/MTF/Pair: OFF
- shape table: OFF

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Dense mode
- encState allocated lazily
- intern table active
- Markov-0 always on (free on miss)
- MTF if OptMTF
- Markov-1 if OptPairPred
- shape interning if OptShapeIntern
- QPack if OptQPack
